# Overview

`OhdsiAtlasClient` is an R client for OHDSI ATLAS 3.0 and WebAPI 3.0. It discovers the
WebAPI root from an ATLAS URL, checks the server version, authenticates with a
personal API key, and gives typed access to sources, vocabularies, concept
sets, cohort definitions, cohort definition sets, CDM results, jobs, and
analysis resources.

Every endpoint in WebAPI 3.0 is also reachable through `call()` and
`request()`, so a missing convenience method never blocks you.

> **Coming from `ROhdsiWebApi`?** Read
> `vignette("migrating-from-rohdsiwebapi", package = "OhdsiAtlasClient")` instead. It maps
> every function you are likely to be using.

# Connecting

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(OhdsiAtlasClient)

atlas <- connectAtlas("https://atlas.example.org")
atlas
```

Discovery tries the common layouts: `/WebAPI`, `/webapi`, a direct WebAPI
root, and `/atlas/WebAPI`. The client refuses WebAPI 2.x.

If ATLAS and WebAPI are served on **different ports or hosts** (common in
development stacks, where the UI is at `:8081` and WebAPI at `:8082`), same-origin
discovery cannot succeed. Pass the WebAPI root directly:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
atlas <- connectAtlas("http://localhost:8082/WebAPI")
```

# Authenticating

Authentication uses a personal API key. Create one in ATLAS under the user
menu -> **API keys**; the plaintext is shown once.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
atlas <- connectAtlas(
  "https://atlas.example.org",
  apiKey = Sys.getenv("OHDSI_ATLAS_CLIENT_API_KEY")
)

# Or connect first and store a key:
atlas <- connectAtlas("https://atlas.example.org")
atlas$login(Sys.getenv("OHDSI_ATLAS_CLIENT_API_KEY"))
atlas$whoami()$user$login
```

A key is looked up in this order: the `apiKey` argument, the
`OHDSI_ATLAS_CLIENT_API_KEY` environment variable, then a stored key (OS keyring, or a
permission-restricted file). There is no username/password login.

# Sources and vocabulary

```{r, eval = FALSE}
sources <- atlas$sources$list()
vapply(sources, `[[`, "", "sourceKey")

concepts <- atlas$concepts$search("EUNOMIA", "diclofenac", rows = 10)
concept <- atlas$concepts$get("EUNOMIA", 1124300)
```

`rows` is applied client-side: WebAPI's search can ignore it, so the client
truncates the result.

# Concept counts

Counts come from the CDM results cache (Achilles). The canonical path is
`cdmResults$conceptCounts()`; `concepts$counts()` is an alias.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
counts <- atlas$cdmResults$conceptCounts("EUNOMIA", c(1124300))
counts[[1]]$values    # record, descendant record, person, descendant person
```

If Achilles has not run against a source, every value is `0` even when the CDM
has data.

# Concept sets

```{r, eval = FALSE}
conceptSet <- atlas$conceptSets$createFromConcepts(
  "Diclofenac ingredients", c(1124300),
  sourceKey = "EUNOMIA", includeDescendants = TRUE
)
expression <- atlas$conceptSets$expression(conceptSet$id)
resolved <- atlas$concepts$resolve("EUNOMIA", expression)
```

# Cohort definitions

```{r, eval = FALSE}
demo <- atlas$cohorts$get(1)
cohort <- atlas$cohorts$create("My cohort", demo$expression)
atlas$cohorts$check(cohort$expression)
atlas$cohorts$sql(cohort$expression)

job <- atlas$cohorts$generate(cohort$id, "EUNOMIA")
job <- atlas$jobs$wait(job, timeout = 600)
```

# Cohort definition sets

A cohort definition set bundle contains cohort expressions and all embedded
concept sets, with a SHA-256 integrity digest. It can be imported into another
ATLAS instance.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
atlas$cohortSets$export(path = "my-cohorts.json")
result <- atlas$cohortSets$import("my-cohorts.json", onConflict = "rename")
result$createdCohorts
```

`onConflict` is one of `"error"`, `"skip"`, `"rename"` (default), or
`"update"`. Use `dryRun = TRUE` to see the plan without writing.

# Schema DDL

WebAPI 3.0 emits DDL only for *results* schemas, not for the CDM itself, and
the endpoints require an admin key.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
atlas$ddl$results(dialect = "postgresql", schema = "results")
atlas$ddl$achilles(dialect = "postgresql", schema = "results")
atlas$ddl$cemResults(dialect = "postgresql", schema = "results")
```

For CDM DDL use `CommonDataModel::writeDdl()`.

# Every endpoint

The bundled catalog contains all 344 WebAPI 3.0 operations. The typed methods
cover the common resources; `call()` and `request()` reach the rest.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
vapply(atlas$endpoints(group = "cohortdefinition"), `[[`, "", "operationId")
atlas$call("cohortdefinition.getCohortDefinitionRaw", id = 1)
atlas$request("GET", "/cohortdefinition/1/info")
```
